sourceDetails.heuristics: Automated checks for common characteristics associated with risk.
sourceDetails.zxcvbn: Estimates how easily a password could be guessed.
sourceDetails.hibp: Checks whether the password appears in public breach records. Only the first 5 characters of its SHA-1 fingerprint are sent to this service, never the password itself.
sourceDetails.llm: Helps explain the content and possible manipulation tactics.
sourceDetails.other: This source contributed to the analysis.
